episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.plot: On his fortieth birthday, arena manager Ben Donovan begins questioning the selfish routines that have kept his life comfortably shallow, while a circus, stubborn rink ice and his eccentric boss ensure there is little time for introspection.

episodes.title: Employee of the Year
episodes.plot: A teen pop star's appearance turns the Sunshine Center into a logistical headache as Crystal stages an employee contest whose result seems suspiciously predetermined.

episodes.title: Heather's Sister
episodes.plot: Ben reluctantly joins Roman and Heather for a double date with Heather's sister Stephanie, only to discover that unusual behavior apparently runs quite efficiently through the family.

episodes.title: Hostile Workplace
episodes.plot: Ben tries to improve morale by making his employees like him and learns that forced friendliness is not a management strategy, while Heather scrambles to replace a departing arena mascot.

episodes.title: Crystal on Ice
episodes.plot: Ben discovers Roman has nowhere sensible to live and takes him in, while Crystal's dislike of an ice show and Alice's attempts to match Alonzo's effortless competence create fresh arena problems.

episodes.title: Lingerie Football
episodes.plot: Crystal's anniversary with her ex-husband Billy forces Ben into facilitating emotional closure, while Roman is assigned to keep Ben's football-player date occupied and manages the task rather too well.

episodes.title: Celebrity Tennis
episodes.plot: Ben and Alonzo enter a celebrity tennis match against Jimmy Connors and Fred Savage, turning a promotional event into an unexpectedly serious contest while Crystal stumbles into a rare moment of closeness with Roman.

episodes.title: The Assistant
episodes.plot: Roman becomes Alice's assistant and proves far more capable than she expected, while Alonzo reveals an old relationship and Crystal decides the Sunshine Center is an appropriate venue for a funeral.

episodes.title: Ben and Vivian
episodes.plot: Ben's uncomplicated one-night stand becomes awkward when Vivian appears at work as Crystal's new assistant, while Crystal attempts responsible parenting and Alonzo is pushed toward the edge by the arena mascot.

episodes.title: Self Help
episodes.plot: A self-help guru booked for the arena is arrested before his seminar, leaving the staff searching for a replacement as Heather's attention toward Ben irritates Roman and Alice confronts her fear of public speaking.

episodes.title: Family Business
episodes.plot: Ben's childhood hockey hero considers coaching the arena's team, so Ben tries to manufacture an ideal family image for Crystal and Roman while Alonzo struggles to recreate his most famous sporting failure for a commercial.

episodes.title: Cohen and Donovan
episodes.plot: A leadership conference brings three monumental egos to the Sunshine Center just as Crystal decides she wants a hands-on role in daily operations, leaving Ben to manage both the speakers and his suddenly enthusiastic boss.

episodes.title: The Best Man
episodes.plot: The Sunshine Center hosts a wedding for two longtime employees, Roman and Heather have their first real fight, and Ben's reaction to his own age gap pushes him to reconsider what he actually wants from his relationships.
